newsitem.title: USA: Tele-Comms new plan pegged to digital.
newsitem.headline: Tele-Comms new plan pegged to digital.

text.p: A new structure announced on Wednesday for Tele-Communications Inc's cable television unit is pegged to the eventual roll-out of digital television, a company spokeswoman said.
The digital TV product, called ALL TV, will offer customers for a fee a package of 85 channels in addition to what they currently receive, said LaRae Marsik.

TCI is keen to roll out digital television and began testing it in Hartford, Conn. on October 21. When TCI is satisfied with digital it will offer it commercially in Hartford and then in other TCI systems.
